description: Use when an agent has several URLs (search results, citations) and needs them all as Markdown at once. Input: urls (1-5 public URLs separated by spaces), optional max_chars per URL (500-20000), flags=1. Output: JSON results[] in input order, each status ok (markdown, title, finalUrl) or error (code, message). Charged once if at least one page is read. Example: ?urls=https://example.com/ https://example.org/ Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

flags.description: 1 = add rule-based prompt-injection signals per page

urls.description: 1-5 public http(s) URLs separated by spaces

name: web_read_batch
title: Web read batch: up to 5 URLs to clean Markdown in one call
